description: Risk responses are not chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that risk treatment processes (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid) are not documented, tracked, or communicated to stakeholders. Organizations should implement risk response planning, tracking systems, and communication protocols to ensure identified risks are addressed systematically.
